notes.title: The Pinball Wizard Stream with Frosty Pop
notes.content:
Do you have any comments, questions, opinions or thoughts on The Pinball Wizard? Stop by the stream we're all ears. Hang out with Chiara as she plays what people are calling "the game of the century". 

-------

In this pinball dungeon crawler, your goal is to dash, hurl, and flip your way to the top of the tower castle. Level up skills, loot treasure, and fight monsters in this cozy single-player game. Explore and discover the key to each room, restore the power of The Eye, and bring peace to the lands.

notes.title: Our New Tower Defence / FPS Game
notes.content:
Today we put up a brand new page for our Tower Defence / FPS-Lite game. Yes, read that again. We've combined and simplified a  few of our favourite genres into a singular arcade experience called [b]Escape From The Red Planet.[/b]  

[previewyoutube=1V5LyNzViio;full][/previewyoutube]

You can check out or Wishlist the game here --> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163480/Escape_From_The_Red_Planet/]Escape From The Red Planet[/url].

A little more detail about the game itself:

Escape From The Red Planet simplifies resource management, tower defence, and first-person mechanics into a singular arcade experience. On the latest mission to Mars, the Orion III crash-landed. With Martian attacks looming, Houston most definitely has a problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984114/b311498402d9ab69c1b0f7a742967f07916c2546.gif[/img]

Some Key Features are:
[olist]
[*]Three different game modes: Level, Survival and Last Stand
[*]Discover the 9 buildable tools for tower offence and defence  
[*]Uncover and fight off each of the many species of Martian 
[*]Toggle between tower and first-person viewing modes to personally pick off some pesky Martians 
[*]25 Levels in Story Mode
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984114/18cf272c2f8e331723b80d5864bc69b46d982941.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it.

Be well. Be Safe. 

// Simply,

The Frosty Pop Team
